{{Quote|My chronological circuits have marked over ten full revolutions of this system's outermost planet around the sun since the Builders left.|translated=1|The Overseer|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
'''Chronological circuitry''', also known as '''chronological circuits''', was a component of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] known as the [[Overseer (droid)|Overseer]]. It was constructed by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] [[Pre-Republic era|before]] the [[Galactic Constitution Conference|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. By [[3956 BBY]], chronological circuitry had allowed the Overseer to record that the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Purnell]] of the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]] had made more than ten complete [[Orbit/Legends|orbits]] since the departure of members of the empire's ruling [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Rakatan ruins (Dantooine)|facility]] on the world [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] at which the Overseer was stationed.

==Description==
Chronological circuitry, also referred to as chronological circuits, was a component of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] known as the [[Overseer (droid)|Overseer]] that allowed them to record the number of [[Orbit/Legends|orbits]] a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] had made since a specific point in [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

==History==
{{Quote|There is no mistake. The Builders constructed my chronological circuitry using the technology of the Star Forge itself. My calculations are infallible.|translated=1|The Overseer|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
[[File:Overseer_droid_dantooine.png|thumb|right|200px|Chronological circuitry was a part of the droid known as the Overseer (pictured).]]
The Overseer's chronological circuitry was created by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] using the technology of the [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-powered [[Factory/Legends|factory]] known as the [[Star Forge]].<ref name="KOTOR" /> In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="3956 BBY">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' to [[3956 BBY]].</ref> when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Bastila Shan]] visited the [[Rakatan ruins (Dantooine)|Rakatan facility]] on<ref name="KOTOR" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], where the Overseer was stationed, the droid told the pair that their chronological circuitry had recorded the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system's]] outermost world,<ref name="KOTOR" /> [[Purnell]],<ref name="TEA" /> having made more than ten complete orbits since the Rakata had departed the installation. That claim let the Jedi deduce that the Infinite Empire's reign [[Pre-Republic era|predated]] the [[Galactic Constitution Conference|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="KOTOR" /> in [[25,053 BBY]].<ref name="SWTORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> When the incredulous Shan doubted the accuracy of the claim, the Overseer expressed confidence in the quality of their chronological circuitry and that the calculations facilitated by the component were "infallible."<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chronological circuitry was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''.<ref name="KOTOR" />
